pick.headline: Supreme Soviet votes the USSR out of existence
pick.summary: On December 26, 1991, the Soviet of the Republics of the USSR Supreme Soviet adopted a declaration recognising that the Soviet Union had ceased to exist.
pick.significance: It was the formal end of the Soviet state.

alternates.headline: Islamic Salvation Front leads Algeria's first-round vote
alternates.summary: On December 26, 1991, the Islamic Salvation Front won a clear lead in the first round of Algeria's parliamentary elections.
alternates.significance: The army canceled the second round in January 1992, setting off a decade of civil war.
